channel.title: The Traitors
channel.desc: As the game reaches the half-way point, are the players inching closer to uncovering the Traitors? The mission encourages everyone to reflect on their time in the castle, and money for the prize pot is not the only tempting thing on offer. As numbers dwindle, tension rises at the Round Table. The evening brings the Faithful a unique opportunity that could change the course of the game - if played correctly.
